races.paceDynamic: Ethereal Charm is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms uncontested from the gates, setting a comfortable rhythm over this seven furlong trip. With Roccobear and Fullstop the only prominent racers, there's minimal early pressure which allows the leader to control fractions through the first half-mile. The large contingent of hold-up horses including Wild Thoughts, Slack Bob, Station Bar and Blue Celestial will be relying on the pace collapsing in the final two furlongs. This tactical setup strongly favours the front end - either the uncontested leader staying on or the prominent racers getting first run on a weakening pace-setter.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leader Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If Ethereal Charm maintains gallop through final furlong
scenarios.body: The uncontested front runner has controlled every fraction and kicks clear when the field comes hunting, with prominent racer Roccobear running into second as closest pursuer. Hold-up horses get their run too late against a horse who has dictated ideal fractions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If Roccobear and Fullstop get first run on weakening leader
scenarios.body: The prominent pair get the jump on a tiring Ethereal Charm entering the final quarter-mile, with Roccobear's superior class telling in a driving finish. The hold-up brigade are still organizing their challenge as the race is being decided up front.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closer Charges
scenarios.trigger: If Wild Thoughts produces her recent winning turn of foot
scenarios.body: The in-form Wild Thoughts gets the perfect setup as Ethereal Charm sets steady fractions before weakening, allowing Saffie Osborne to time her challenge to perfection. Station Bar and Blue Celestial also benefit from the collapse but can't match the winner's acceleration.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Ethereal Charm stops badly and prominent racers fade
scenarios.body: The lone leader hits the wall hard in the final furlong with Roccobear and Fullstop also emptying, creating chaos as multiple hold-up horses converge simultaneously. Hello Humphrey and Personal Pride emerge from the pack in a blanket finish decided by who gets the clearest run.

watchPoints.text: Ethereal Charm must be watched closely for any signs of greenness or inexperience under pressure given 203-day layoff and claiming rider
Monitor how aggressively Roccobear and Fullstop track the leader through early stages as they hold keys to pace pressure
Wild Thoughts' position turning for home will be crucial given her need for strong pace and recent winning momentum
Check if any of the hold-up horses get caught wide or in traffic as clear runs will be premium in this tactical affair
Watch for early market moves on Hello Humphrey and Personal Pride as both return from significant layoffs with fitness questions

races.paceDynamic: Tactical Plan will lead from the gates with Jazzy Baby and I Am Me sitting prominent, creating a controlled gallop over the mile trip. The large field of hold-up horses including Sea Founder, Berry Clever, Atlantis Blue, and Billy Mill will settle towards the rear, relying on the pace to develop. With only one confirmed front runner and most rivals happy to wait, the tempo will be modest early before quickening from the 3f pole. This race shape heavily favours prominent racers and those with tactical speed to position close to the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Suits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Tactical Plan leads uncontested with Jazzy Baby tracking
scenarios.body: The moderate gallop allows prominent runners to dictate terms and kick clear when the field comes under pressure. Hold-up horses face a wall of traffic and insufficient pace collapse to sweep past late runners.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Finish Catches Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens significantly from halfway and leaders tire
scenarios.body: The increased tempo sets up perfectly for hold-up horses with Berry Clever and Sea Founder finding gaps to deliver their finishing kicks. Class horses like Sea Founder and Billy Mill benefit from the stronger gallop.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Positioning Key
scenarios.trigger: If early pace is crawling then suddenly accelerates 4f out
scenarios.body: Horses positioned in midfield avoid the early crawl but stay close enough to respond when the race develops in earnest. Those with tactical pace like Ash Wednesday can improve position before the sprint.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Favours Outsiders
scenarios.trigger: If there's significant interference or very uneven pace
scenarios.body: The disrupted rhythm levels the playing field allowing unconsidered horses like Emery Down with his low weight to capitalise on others' misfortune. Jockey switches and headgear changes prove decisive factors.

watchPoints.text: Tactical Plan's jumping and early pace-setting crucial as sole leader - if he goes too fast early he'll set it up for closers
Traffic problems likely in straight with 8+ hold-up horses needing room - watch for horses getting hampered on rails
Sea Founder's response to Oisin Murphy's urgings critical - this class performer needs to show willing from the back
Ash Wednesday's adaptation to tongue-tie equipment in running - could transform his finishing effort if effective
Weather conditions affecting the standard surface - any deterioration could impact hold-up horses' ground coverage

races.paceDynamic: Perfect Location will likely take the early lead with Tenzi, Bessie Wallis and Portacloy tracking close behind in the opening exchanges. The lack of natural front-runners beyond Perfect Location suggests she can dictate a steady tempo without fierce early pressure. With Space Bear and Leonie likely held up at the rear, the race will develop into a tactical affair where the prominent runners can conserve energy before the sprint home. This pace scenario strongly favours hold-up horses who can unleash late runs, particularly Space Bear with her proven closing ability.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominant
scenarios.trigger: If Perfect Location sets uncontested fractions and the pace is steady
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows the patient riders to time their runs perfectly from off the pace. Space Bear and Leonie benefit most from this tactical setup with their proven closing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent battle decides
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent quartet engage earlier than expected creating genuine pace
scenarios.body: Tenzi and Perfect Location can benefit from their forward positions while the hold-up horses find insufficient pace to close into. The race becomes a test of who can sustain their effort longest from the front group.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late surge from midfield
scenarios.trigger: If Portacloy or Bessie Wallis get the perfect trip tracking the leaders
scenarios.body: Their class tells in the final furlong as they benefit from cover before producing late acceleration. The combination of race fitness and tactical positioning proves decisive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Wire-to-wire winner
scenarios.trigger: If Perfect Location breaks cleanly and is allowed complete control of the tempo
scenarios.body: She dictates throughout and has enough left in reserve to hold off all challengers despite carrying them into the race. Her proven front-running ability on this surface becomes the deciding factor.

watchPoints.text: Perfect Location could get an uncontested lead and steal the race if allowed to dictate soft fractions throughout
Space Bear's finishing kick depends entirely on there being enough pace to close into from her hold-up position
Bessie Wallis returning after 150 days absence may need the run despite her trainer's low strike rate this fortnight
Leonie needs Oisin Murphy to find cover early as she relies completely on a strong pace to unleash her finishing effort
Portacloy faces a fitness test after 184 days off but has shown she can win fresh based on her previous pattern

races.paceDynamic: Port Darwin will lead uncontested with Wedonttellthetruth settling in second, creating a sustainable gallop over this 1m4f trip. The majority field comprises hold-up horses (Blackisthenewblack, Cospicua, Saxophonic, Rajbello, Goldfinder, Make It Up) who will need the pace to develop for their finishing kicks. With only two horses showing early pace against nine hold-up types, the leaders can dictate terms and potentially steal a march. This race shape strongly favours front-running and prominent tactics, as the lack of pace pressure allows the early leaders to control the tempo and kick clear when it matters.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leaders Control Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Port Darwin and Wedonttellthetruth establish an uncontested lead through steady fractions
scenarios.body: The front pair can quicken off the bend while the hold-up brigade still has work to do, with the lack of early pace leaving closers too much ground to make up. Port Darwin's stamina and Wedonttellthetruth's recent win over 1m2f give them the tactical edge.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely slow and the field remains tightly bunched turning for home
scenarios.body: Cospicua and Blackisthenewblack can utilise their proven finishing kicks, with Cospicua's recent 12f wins showing she thrives when getting a strong gallop late. The compressed finish plays to their strengths with quality jockeys Murphy and Edmunds able to time their runs.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Port Darwin fails to maintain gallop or Wedonttellthetruth presses too early creating unsustainable fractions
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where Saxophonic and Make It Up can show their turn of foot, though both carry warnings about fading in the finish which limits their appeal. The tactical chaos could suit an opportunistic ride.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the market leaders underperform and gaps appear mid-race for an unconsidered runner
scenarios.body: Goldfinder's consistent fourth-place finishes suggest ability waiting to be unlocked, while trainer Chamings' excellent strike rate (1/2) hints at confidence. The hold-up style could pay if others hit traffic problems.

watchPoints.text: Port Darwin could steal this if maintaining gallop to the line, as the lack of early pace pressure plays perfectly to his front-running style
Cospicua's recent 12f form makes her the main threat from the rear, but she needs the pace to develop properly for her trademark late kick
Wedonttellthetruth showed improved form winning last time and the step up to 1m4f should suit her prominent racing style
Several runners carry fade-in-finish warnings (Saxophonic, Make It Up, Tonyfromhr) making their chances dependent on a strong gallop throughout
The going has deteriorated to Standard-to-Slow which may not suit some, though most runners have shown form on similar surfaces
